shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب

notes: Two «ح» branches each end at يحيى بن يعمر and repeat their own names, so they are two groups. The names written once after the last «ح» (ابن عمر, then عمر) are the shared tail.
«حدثني أبي عمر بن الخطاب» is one link, the name alone (rule 7). «أبي» in the second branch is the father of عبيد الله, named only by relation.
«فوفق لنا عبد الله بن عمر» — the one asked and answering is a link (rule 6). «- وهذا حديثه -» is an editor gloss, left out. The Prophet ends the chain; «يا عمر» in the saying is not a link.
